abstract: This paper examines the “right” geographic definition of relevant markets by analyzing how excise tax pass-through varies with local competition in the retail gasoline market of a large metropolitan city. Using a natural experiment from three unanticipated and exogenous fuel tax hikes and detailed station-level price data, we show that average pass-through is invariant to the number of nearby competitors across various geographic definitions. This contrasts with theoretical predictions and prior island-based evidence, suggesting that the entire metropolitan area functions as a single market. Our findings challenge standard isodistance- or isochrone-based market delineations used in academic research and competition policy.
title: What is the “right” geographic market definition?
title_zh: 什么是“正确”的地理市场界定？

abstract: Abstract Recent research in economic history argues for using a household life cycle standard‐of‐living approach that includes the income and expenses of all household members and considers fluctuations in the household over the life course. This study builds on that approach by empirically examining the development of living standards in male‐headed households in Stockholm 1800–80, linking individuals and their households in the tax records throughout the life cycle. We compile a random sample of approximately 400 male‐headed households to examine how living standards developed and whether they were able to save to mitigate income decline in old age. Distinguishing between manual‐ and non‐manual‐worker households, this study finds that the manual‐worker household size outgrew income in early adulthood, creating a temporary downturn in welfare ratios. Living standards rose in subsequent stages but declined again when the head of the household approached old age. Manual‐worker households suffered a more pronounced decline in income during these later years than non‐manual‐worker households. The latter had better opportunities to smooth consumption over the life cycle by setting money aside, although manual‐worker households that survived into old age had some capacity for small savings, which may have eased but not offset the decline.
abstract_zh: 摘要 近期经济史研究主张采用家庭生命周期生活水平评估方法，该方法涵盖所有家庭成员的收入与支出，并考虑家庭在生命历程中的波动。本研究在此基础上，通过实证考察1800至1880年间斯德哥尔摩以男性为户主的家庭生活水平发展情况，将税收记录中的个体及其家庭贯穿整个生命周期进行关联。我们编制了约400个男性户主家庭的随机样本，以探究生活水平如何演变，以及他们是否能够储蓄以缓解老年期收入下降。通过区分体力劳动者家庭与非体力劳动者家庭，研究发现体力劳动者家庭在成年早期家庭规模增长超过收入，导致福利比率暂时下降。生活水平在后续阶段有所上升，但当户主接近老年时再次下降。体力劳动者家庭在晚年阶段收入下降幅度较非体力劳动者家庭更为显著。后者通过预留资金，在生命周期内平滑消费方面拥有更好条件，尽管存活至老年的体力劳动者家庭具备一定的小额储蓄能力，这可能缓解但未能抵消收入下降的影响。
title: Life‐cycle living standards of male‐headed households: Evidence from Stockholm, 1800–80
title_zh: 男性户主家庭的生命周期生活水平：来自斯德哥尔摩的证据（1800–1880年）

abstract: Abstract On the basis of price data collected from Gresham's Daybook and Johnson's letters, this article re‐examines a conventional argument in the literature: that currency depreciation during the Great Debasement made English cloth cheaper and thus stimulated an export boom. The price data reveal that the purchase prices of English wool and cloth rose at roughly same rate as the depreciation of pound sterling. The two effects of coinage debasement – inflation and currency depreciation – largely offset each other. Depreciation alone is insufficient to explain the sustained expansion of English exports, rather, strong foreign demand was likely to provide the underlying momentum for the English cloth boom.
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于从格雷沙姆日记和约翰逊信件中收集的价格数据，本文重新审视了文献中的一个传统论点：即大贬值期间货币贬值使英国布料更便宜，从而刺激了出口繁荣。价格数据显示，英国羊毛和布料的购买价格上升幅度与英镑贬值幅度大致相同。铸币贬值的两个效应——通货膨胀与货币贬值——在很大程度上相互抵消。仅凭贬值不足以解释英国出口的持续扩张，相反，强劲的外国需求可能为英国布料繁荣提供了根本动力。
title: The Great Debasement and English overseas trade: Gresham and Johnson in context
title_zh: 大贬值和英国海外贸易：格雷欣与约翰逊的历史背景

abstract: Abstract Existing statistics about England's interwar housing market are sparse and based on outdated sources and methods. This article seeks to improve upon them by drawing on mortgage data from a major London‐based building society and using the hedonic method of price index measurement to construct house price and rent indices for residential houses that are robust to intertemporal sampling differences. It is found that house prices and rents in England both rose significantly between 1919 and 1926 but moderated thereafter and declined throughout the 1930s housing boom. Further evidence indicates that there was excess supply in the housing market during the boom, driven by cheap money and a deliberate strategy by building societies of ‘making the market’ by fuelling private house construction.
abstract_zh: 摘要 关于英格兰两次世界大战期间住房市场的现有统计数据稀少，且基于过时的资料和方法。本文旨在通过利用一家位于伦敦的大型建房互助协会的抵押贷款数据，并采用特征价格指数测量方法，构建对跨期样本差异具有稳健性的住宅房价与租金指数，从而改进现有统计。研究发现，1919年至1926年间，英格兰的房价和租金均显著上涨，但此后趋于缓和，并在20世纪30年代的住房繁荣期间持续下降。进一步证据表明，繁荣期间住房市场存在过度供给，这由廉价货币以及建房互助协会通过刺激私人住房建设来“做市”的刻意策略所驱动。
title: Measuring the interwar housing boom: House prices and rents in England, 1913–39
title_zh: 两次世界大战期间住房繁荣的测度：1913–39年英格兰房价与租金

abstract: This paper investigates how the Indonesian War of Independence (1945‒9) influenced staple food prices, and how fluctuations in those prices, in turn, shaped the trajectory and dynamics of the conflict. We compiled a dataset comprising more than 8600 prices for staple foods covering the entire Indonesian archipelago from 1939‒49, allowing us to estimate the effects of wartime conditions and the main Dutch military campaigns on food prices. We find that wartime price peaks were much more severe and prolonged than studies previously assumed, both in and outside Java. We show that the first large military operation, Operation Product, was partly motivated by high rice prices and demonstrate that these prices were significantly reduced across Java and Sumatra after the end of the military campaign. We then use a second dataset on wartime wages to estimate nutritional standards. These combined data suggest a very low nutritional status of urban unskilled wage labourers – often below the family subsistence level – in 1946 and the first half of 1947. Our results point to broader entitlement failures driven by weak market connectivity amidst military and economic warfare.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了印度尼西亚独立战争（1945-1949年）如何影响主食价格，以及这些价格的波动又如何反过来塑造了冲突的轨迹与动态。我们编制了一个包含1939年至1949年间覆盖整个印尼群岛的8600多个主食价格的数据集，从而能够估算战时条件及荷兰主要军事行动对食品价格的影响。研究发现，战时价格峰值比以往研究假设的更为严重且持续时间更长，无论是在爪哇岛内外均是如此。我们表明，第一次大规模军事行动——“产品行动”——部分是由大米价格高涨所驱动，并证明在军事行动结束后，爪哇和苏门答腊的大米价格显著下降。随后，我们利用第二个关于战时工资的数据集来估算营养标准。这些综合数据表明，1946年至1947年上半年，城市非技术工人的营养状况极低——往往低于家庭基本生活水平。我们的研究结果指向了在军事与经济战争背景下，市场连通性薄弱所导致的更广泛的应享权利失败。
title: Between famine and freedom: Food prices during the Indonesian War of Independence, 1945–9
title_zh: 饥荒与自由之间：印度尼西亚独立战争时期的食品价格（1945-1949）
